prompts.05:
Generate ONE fresh image entirely from this text, with NO reference images or reuse of previous images. Square 1024x1024.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Style is the overriding priority: an authentic modern 3D animated feature film still, original family-animation character design, extravagantly cartoon proportions, very large head, huge expressive eyes, tiny nose, appealing exaggerated facial shapes, small torso and stylized hands. Sophisticated bright cinematic 3D rendering, polished glossy stylized materials and sculpted curls. Absolutely not a photograph with a filter or a realistically proportioned human.
Subject: a woman in her early 30s, curly auburn shoulder-length hair, clearly visible freckles, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard-yellow knit sweater, happily enjoying coffee. Use highly exaggerated animated proportions.
Composition: exuberant close-up from slightly below eye level, three-quarter view; her oversized face and bouncy hair dominate the square. She cradles a small steaming coffee cup near her delighted smile, looking at the coffee with huge lively eyes. A flaky croissant on a little plate is visible in the near foreground at the bottom, rendered with the same stylized 3D language.
Setting and lighting: a charming stylized cafe with curved furniture shapes softly out of focus, brilliant golden sunlight, soft turquoise background accents, cinematic rim light through translucent curls and pleasing warm skin shading. Charming expressive pose and feature-film polish throughout.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos or watermarks. Single finished image, no grid or collage.
prompts.06:
Create ONE fresh image solely from this text, without ANY reference image. Square 1024x1024. Use case: stylized-concept.
An authentic macro photograph of a physical LEGO minifigure in a cafe built entirely from LEGO bricks. The medium and real toy anatomy are the priority.
The single minifigure represents a woman in her early 30s with a standard cylindrical YELLOW plastic head, a flat printed smiling face with freckles, printed round tortoiseshell glasses, and a molded auburn curly shoulder-length hair piece. Standard LEGO minifigure proportions: trapezoidal torso, jointed rigid arms, yellow C-shaped claw hands, short block legs, no realistic human anatomy. Her mustard-yellow plastic torso has a printed cable-knit sweater pattern, not fabric. She enjoys a coffee in a tiny molded LEGO mug held by one claw hand. A recognizable little brown LEGO croissant accessory rests nearby on a stud-built cafe table.
Composition: show the entire minifigure seated sideways on a brick-built stool at a narrow cafe counter, seen at minifigure eye level in a three-quarter side view. Include her visible short legs, the table and croissant, and a brick-built espresso machine in the setting. Construct the whole visible cafe from tactile interlocking bricks, tiles, studs and transparent window elements. The figure is one small toy in the physical set.
Materials and lighting: credible injection-molded shiny ABS plastic with seams, tiny scuffs, hard molded edges and visible stud connections. Warm daylight through a LEGO window, shallow depth of field from a macro lens, realistic miniature toy photography. All objects are LEGO-scale plastic. No human skin, organic hair, fabric, cartoon rendering or ordinary human body. No readable text, captions, letters, numbers, signatures, logos or watermarks, including on bricks. One single finished image.
prompts.07:
Create ONE fresh 1024x1024 square image solely from text. Do not use any reference image or previous generated image.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Authentic British handmade stop-motion plasticine comedy film frame. Style dictates every shape: a peculiar, charming woman puppet with an elongated bulbous face, comically large nose, a very wide toothy grin containing chunky separate teeth, and protruding white googly OVAL eyes with little pupils. Strong hand-sculpted asymmetry, thumbprints, tool marks, slight lumps and seams clearly visible in all colored clay. It must look like a practical plasticine puppet photographed on a miniature set.
Character: woman in her early 30s, curly auburn shoulder-length hair made of chunky uneven clay coils, freckles pressed and painted on her clay cheeks, handmade round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard-yellow sweater sculpted in clay with incised knit texture. She is gleefully enjoying coffee; one long puppet arm lifts a tiny mug and her other arm rests on a round cafe table, with a handmade clay croissant on its saucer.
Composition: medium-wide full-body SIDE PROFILE scene showing her long-nosed face in expressive profile and her comically thin legs and big simple shoes dangling from a too-tall handmade chair. The table and crooked cafe window establish the miniature set. Her huge toothy grin is unmistakable from the side-three-quarter profile.
Setting: handcrafted modest cafe, slightly wonky painted wood furniture, miniature patterned flooring, uneven walls, handmade curtains. Earthy muted reds, mustard, cream and dusty greens; practical warm tungsten lamps, soft stop-motion set shadows, tactile matte clay with tiny oily highlights. Every surface should feel handmade and imperfect, not smooth polished CGI. Anatomical exaggeration and stop-motion puppet appeal are paramount.
No text, signage, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, collage or multiple frames.
prompts.08:
Create ONE fresh image only from the following text, no reference image. Final canvas exactly 1024x1024 square.
Use case: stylized-concept.
Authentic 16-bit SNES-era JRPG pixel art cafe map, as if a screenshot of an actual early-1990s tile-based game with the entire HUD hidden. Build the whole image as a coherent 256x256 pixel low-resolution artwork displayed at EXACT 4x nearest-neighbor enlargement. Each source pixel is a clean solid 4x4 block. A STRICT total of 32 flat colors for the whole image. Crisp hard square pixels, intentional pixel clusters, tile repetition, flat stepped shading. Absolutely NO anti-aliasing, smooth gradients, blur, painterly surfaces, cinematic camera depth, 3D rendering or modern high-resolution illustration.
Wide overhead three-quarter/top-down orthographic JRPG cafe tileset. A small cozy cafe interior occupies the square: visible wooden plank floor tiles, counter, stools, wall shelves, windows, two small tables and potted plants arranged on a clear tile grid. The scene is the subject, with a SINGLE TINY chibi sprite character occupying only about 24x32 source pixels and situated off-center at one table. Show the full floor-plan view with much more environment than character, not a character portrait.
This tiny sprite represents a woman in her early 30s with curly auburn shoulder-length hair, round tortoiseshell glasses, freckles suggested by a few dark pixels and a mustard-yellow knit sweater indicated by simple pixel clusters. Classic JRPG sprite anatomy: big 2D head, extremely short body and stubby limbs. She sits happily enjoying a coffee from a tiny pixel mug. A recognizable golden crescent croissant sprite sits beside her coffee on the table. Indicate steam using a few discrete pale pixels.
Palette: warm russet and chestnut wood, cream highlights, mustard clothing, auburn hair, muted teal furniture, deep plum outlines. Let the limited palette and grid govern all anatomy, details, lighting and perspective.
NO text anywhere, no letters or numbers, no menu boards, no UI, no HUD, no speech bubbles, no captions, signatures, logos or watermarks. One authentic game-scene image, no collage.
